18501o5.q: The supplementary panel shown, placed under a danger sign, indicates the distance between the sign and the point where the hazard begins
18501o5.why: A panel showing only a distance, with no arrows, under a danger sign gives the distance from the sign to where the hazard starts.

1so4r1m.q: The supplementary panel shown can be placed under signs to complete their meaning
1so4r1m.why: A supplementary panel (pannello integrativo) never stands alone; it goes under another sign to complete or specify its meaning, here by giving a distance.

1s8h9uw.q: The supplementary panel shown, placed under an information sign, serves to specify the distance remaining to reach the point indicated by the sign
1s8h9uw.why: Under an information sign, a panel with metres or kilometres states how far it is to reach the place the sign points to.

1bjhbu5.q: The supplementary panel shown, placed under a mandatory or prohibition sign, indicates the distance from which the requirement begins
1bjhbu5.why: Under a mandatory or prohibition sign, a panel showing only a distance tells you how far ahead the requirement begins.

zbx9m3.q: The supplementary panel shown in figure A indicates the metres of road already travelled
zbx9m3.why: A distance panel shows how far ahead the point is, not how far you have already driven.

f5csp8.q: The supplementary panel shown indicates the gradient of a road
f5csp8.why: Gradient is shown by a dedicated danger sign; the panel shown gives a distance in metres or kilometres.

4q6owo.q: The supplementary panel shown in figure A indicates the safety distance to keep from the vehicle in front
4q6owo.why: The panel gives the distance to the point the sign refers to, not the safe following distance from the vehicle ahead.

7synlz.q: The supplementary panel shown indicates the width of a road
7synlz.why: The panel shown gives a distance in metres or kilometres, not the width of the road.

1v28t37.q: The supplementary panel shown, placed under the danger sign, indicates the length of the dangerous stretch of road
1v28t37.why: A panel without arrows shows the distance to the start of the hazard; the length of the stretch is shown by a panel with vertical arrows.

1p03yca.q: The supplementary panel shown, placed under a danger sign, indicates the length of the dangerous stretch of road
1p03yca.why: The vertical arrows on either side of the distance show the extent of the dangerous stretch, which starts at the sign.

2qfv6b.q: The supplementary panel shown, placed under a mandatory sign, indicates the length of the road stretch in which the sign's requirement applies
2qfv6b.why: The panel with arrows gives the length of the stretch over which the mandatory sign applies.

7qx2as.q: The supplementary panel shown can be placed under a prohibition sign
7qx2as.why: The extent panel can complete danger, prohibition and mandatory signs, showing the length of the stretch concerned.

47owbd.q: The supplementary panel shown in figure B, placed under a danger sign, indicates in kilometres the length of the dangerous stretch of road
47owbd.why: Panel B, with arrows and kilometres, gives the length of the dangerous stretch, here 2.8 km.

ulnie4.q: The sign shown indicates the length of a road stretch with dangerous curves in succession
ulnie4.why: Under the dangerous-curves sign, the panel with arrows and 380 m gives the length of the stretch with successive curves.

1m6rqgv.q: The supplementary panel shown in figure A requires you to continue straight ahead for 380 metres
1m6rqgv.why: The panel with arrows and a distance shows the length of the stretch where the sign applies; it does not order you to go straight.

1smcwtf.q: The supplementary panel shown in figure A indicates the safety distance to keep in the rain
1smcwtf.why: The panel shows the length of a road stretch; it has nothing to do with safe following distance.

ymk33k.q: The supplementary panel shown indicates the distance between the sign and the point where the hazard begins
ymk33k.why: The vertical arrows show the length of the hazardous stretch; distance to where the hazard starts is shown by a figure alone, without arrows.

2bysfh.q: The sign shown indicates the distance between the sign and the start of the road in poor condition
2bysfh.why: The panel with arrows gives the length of the uneven road stretch, which starts at the sign itself.

1labicj.q: The supplementary panel shown in figure A indicates the height of a viaduct
1labicj.why: The panel with arrows and metres shows the length of a stretch, not the height of a viaduct.

4bdyeu.q: The sign shown prohibits parking from 7.30 to 19.00
4bdyeu.why: The no-parking sign with the 7.30-19.00 panel applies in those hours; outside them parking is allowed.

1gthuyp.q: The sign shown prohibits transit from 7.30 to 19.00
1gthuyp.why: The no-entry prohibition with the time panel applies only from 7.30 to 19.00; outside those hours you may pass.

azbs4x.q: The supplementary panel (A), placed under sign (B), prohibits transit by pedestrians only during the hours shown
azbs4x.why: Sign B bans pedestrians; panel A limits the ban to the hours 7.30-19.00.

qjff1i.q: The supplementary panel shown in figure B indicates the hours, on every day, during which the sign applies
qjff1i.why: A panel with hours only, without symbols, applies every day during the hours shown.

qkjguw.q: The sign shown allows motorcycles to pass only during the hours shown
qkjguw.why: The sign bans motorcycles during 7.30-19.00; outside those hours they may pass.

ztabou.q: The sign shown indicates that the horn may be used from 7.30 to 19.00
ztabou.why: The sign prohibits using the horn during the hours shown, 7.30 to 19.00.

1scq6dk.q: The sign shown indicates the opening hours of a limited traffic zone
1scq6dk.why: The pedestrian-route sign with the holiday panel applies on holidays 8-20; it does not show limited traffic zone (ZTL) hours.

1h0usoh.q: The supplementary panel shown in figure B indicates the hours in which you may drive without lights
1h0usoh.why: The panel only gives the hours when a sign is valid; it says nothing about driving without lights.

1ywwc6u.q: The supplementary panel shown in figure B indicates the time bands during which alternate-plate driving applies
1ywwc6u.why: The time panel just limits when a sign applies; it has no connection to alternate-plate driving.

k109wz.q: The supplementary panel shown limits the validity of the sign under which it is placed to holidays and the time band indicated
k109wz.why: The cross means holidays (giorni festivi): the sign applies only on those days and in the hours shown.

16rihzx.q: The supplementary panel shown, placed under a regulatory sign, specifies that the sign applies only on holidays and in the time bands indicated
16rihzx.why: The panel with a cross and hours restricts the rule to holidays and the hours shown.

ajs5qn.q: The sign shown allows transit on holidays and in the time bands indicated, for pedestrians only
ajs5qn.why: The pedestrian-route sign with the holiday 8-20 panel reserves the road for pedestrians only on those days and hours.

1rupcai.q: The sign shown prohibits parking in the time band indicated, on holidays
1rupcai.why: The no-parking sign with a cross and hours applies only on holidays, in the hours shown.

xt1i9t.q: The sign shown allows transit from 8.00 to 20.00 on holidays for cyclists only
xt1i9t.why: The cycle-route sign with the holiday panel applies from 8.00 to 20.00 on holidays and reserves the route for cyclists.

5ku9k6.q: The sign shown prohibits transit from 8.00 to 20.00 on holidays
5ku9k6.why: The no-entry sign with the cross panel applies only on holidays, from 8.00 to 20.00.

1va66qs.q: The supplementary panel shown indicates the entry hours of a cemetery
1va66qs.why: The cross stands for holidays, not a cemetery: the panel limits the sign to holidays from 8 to 20.

12xjips.q: The supplementary panel shown indicates the opening hours of churches
12xjips.why: The cross in the panel means holidays; it does not show church opening hours.

1pf7zkl.q: The supplementary panel shown indicates the time of religious services
1pf7zkl.why: The cross symbolises holidays and the hours show when the sign applies, not religious services.

1v1ljtn.q: The sign shown indicates that you may park every day in the time band indicated
1v1ljtn.why: The cross panel limits the parking permission to holidays only, 8.00 to 20.00, not every day.

37bxhs.q: The supplementary panel shown applies on working days
37bxhs.why: The cross means holidays; working days are shown by crossed hammers.

1lubxdm.q: The sign shown allows motorcycles to pass on Sunday from 8.00 to 20.00
1lubxdm.why: The sign bans motorcycles on holidays from 8.00 to 20.00; it does not allow them, and it is not limited to Sundays.

v9pltg.q: The supplementary panel shown, placed under a sign, limits its validity to working days and the time bands indicated
v9pltg.why: The crossed hammers mean working days (giorni lavorativi): the sign applies only on those days and hours.

axrtjc.q: The sign shown prohibits transit in the time band indicated, on working days
axrtjc.why: The no-entry sign with crossed hammers and hours applies on working days, in the hours shown.

f629wu.q: The supplementary panel shown indicates the time band, on working days, during which the requirement of the sign it is placed under applies
f629wu.why: Crossed hammers with hours restrict the rule to working days in the time band shown.

1et9cl5.q: The sign shown prohibits parking in the time band indicated on working days
1et9cl5.why: The no-parking sign with hammers and hours applies only on working days, in the hours shown.

ewy5ji.q: The supplementary panel shown, placed under a mandatory sign, indicates that it applies from 8.00 to 20.00 on working days
ewy5ji.why: The panel with hammers and hours limits the mandatory sign to working days, from 8.00 to 20.00.

1c92lfp.q: The sign shown prohibits transit to lorries with a gross mass over 3.5 t at the time indicated, on working days
1c92lfp.why: The ban on lorries over 3.5 t applies on working days, from 8.00 to 20.00.

1mwict6.q: The supplementary panel shown indicates that the sign it is combined with applies every day, but only in the hours indicated
1mwict6.why: The crossed hammers limit the sign to working days only, not every day.

1idgg4h.q: The supplementary panel shown indicates the opening hours of a tool museum
1idgg4h.why: The crossed hammers are the symbol for working days, not for a museum.

19l2vv8.q: The supplementary panel shown indicates the opening hours of breakdown recovery workshops
19l2vv8.why: The crossed hammers mean working days and the hours show when the sign applies, not recovery workshops.

ycnmql.q: The sign shown is reserved for breakdown recovery vehicles
ycnmql.why: The parking sign with the hammers panel allows parking on working days 8-20; it is not reserved for recovery vehicles.

qe7tm5.q: The supplementary panel shown indicates that the sign it is combined with applies on holidays
qe7tm5.why: The hammers panel means working days; holidays are shown with a cross.

o7dcnc.q: The supplementary panel shown, placed under the PARKING sign, indicates that you may park on holidays from 8.00 to 20.00
o7dcnc.why: The hammers mean working days: parking is allowed on working days from 8.00 to 20.00, not on holidays.

hktb9a.q: The sign shown prohibits transit to the vehicles indicated only
hktb9a.why: The panel showing a vehicle restricts the no-entry ban to the vehicles depicted only.

jjqj4e.q: The sign shown prohibits parking for the vehicles indicated
jjqj4e.why: The no-parking sign with a vehicle panel applies only to the vehicles depicted.

1kqjoa.q: The sign shown prohibits parking for articulated lorries
1kqjoa.why: The no-parking sign with the articulated-lorry panel applies to articulated lorries (autoarticolati).

zp0egs.q: The supplementary panel shown indicates that the sign it is combined with applies only to the vehicles depicted
zp0egs.why: A panel showing a vehicle limits the sign to that category of vehicle only.

o6o1sb.q: The supplementary panel shown can be combined with a mandatory sign
o6o1sb.why: The vehicle panel can complete both mandatory and prohibition signs, limiting them to that category.

1levq0b.q: The supplementary panel shown can be combined with a prohibition sign
1levq0b.why: The vehicle panel can be combined with a prohibition, which then applies only to that vehicle type.

11gkfdi.q: The supplementary panel shown indicates a mechanic's workshop for lorry trains
11gkfdi.why: The panel shows which vehicle category the sign applies to; it does not mark a workshop.

gn7vu6.q: The supplementary panel shown indicates a filling station for heavy vehicles only
gn7vu6.why: The vehicle panel restricts a sign to that category; it does not indicate a filling station.

1xyp2nc.q: The sign shown allows parking for articulated lorries
1xyp2nc.why: The sign is a no-parking sign and the panel applies it to articulated lorries: they may not park.

1x022mp.q: The sign shown prescribes that articulated lorries may pass
1x022mp.why: The sign is a no-entry ban and the panel limits it to articulated lorries: they may not pass.

7f3hdh.q: The supplementary panel shown, placed under the PARKING sign, indicates that all heavy vehicles may park
7f3hdh.why: Under the parking sign, the panel reserves the area for the depicted vehicle type only, not all heavy vehicles.

11zr876.q: The supplementary panel (A), placed under a prohibition sign, highlights the point where the requirement begins
11zr876.why: The upward vertical arrow under a prohibition marks the point where the rule begins.

1c7az14.q: The sign shown indicates that the parking ban begins at that point
1c7az14.why: The upward arrow under the no-parking sign shows the ban starts at that point.

fy445x.q: The sign shown highlights the start of the area where parking is possible
fy445x.why: The upward-arrow panel under the parking sign marks the start of the parking area.

j1omb2.q: The sign shown highlights the point where the stopping ban begins
j1omb2.why: The upward arrow under the no-stopping sign marks the point where the ban begins.

ufs5bj.q: The sign shown highlights the start of the pedestrian route
ufs5bj.why: The upward arrow under the pedestrian-route sign marks the start of the route.

1at24h7.q: The panel shown (A) indicates an uphill road
1at24h7.why: A panel with a vertical arrow marks where the sign's rule begins; an uphill road has its own danger sign.

1t79sh1.q: The panel shown (A) indicates the obligation to continue straight ahead
1t79sh1.why: The upward arrow marks where the sign begins to apply; it is not an order to go straight.

nzyerf.q: The panel shown (A) indicates the end of a one-way road
nzyerf.why: The panel with an upward arrow marks the start of a restriction or area, not the end of a one-way street.

10g3gi4.q: The panel shown (B) indicates the lane reserved for city buses
10g3gi4.why: The horizontal arrow shows the direction in which the sign's validity starts; a bus lane has its own sign.

1qbgqyn.q: The sign shown highlights the point where the area designated for parking ends
1qbgqyn.why: A single arrow under the parking sign marks the start of the parking area, not its end.

11s27l6.q: The panel shown (A), placed under a danger sign, highlights the point where the danger ends
11s27l6.why: A vertical arrow under a danger sign marks where the hazard begins; this panel does not mark its end.

104029q.q: The sign shown indicates that the parking ban continues
104029q.why: Opposite arrows under the no-parking sign show that the ban continues.

1f7f1tc.q: The sign shown confirms the continuation of the overtaking ban
1f7f1tc.why: The no-overtaking sign with opposite arrows confirms that the ban continues.

1x32h0b.q: The sign shown indicates the continuation of the maximum speed limit
1x32h0b.why: The speed limit with opposite arrows indicates that the limit continues beyond the sign.

13mtsb5.q: The sign shown indicates the continuation of the slippery road stretch
13mtsb5.why: The panel with opposite arrows under the slippery-road sign shows that the stretch continues.

2gq0li.q: The sign shown indicates that stopping is prohibited both before and after the sign
2gq0li.why: Opposite arrows under the no-stopping sign mean the ban applies both before and after the sign.

sr202c.q: The supplementary panel shown (A), placed under a danger sign, indicates its continuation
sr202c.why: Opposite arrows under a danger sign indicate that the hazard continues.

1u7y6ay.q: The supplementary panel shown (A) indicates to turn back
1u7y6ay.why: Opposite arrows show the sign continues; they do not tell you to turn back.

16im7ws.q: The sign shown indicates the end of the area designated for parking
16im7ws.why: Opposite arrows under the parking sign show that the area continues, not that it ends.

1cfv3ll.q: The supplementary panel shown (A) indicates alternating one-way traffic
1cfv3ll.why: Opposite arrows show continuation of the sign; alternating one-way traffic has its own sign.

i98vtw.q: The supplementary panel shown (A), placed under a danger sign, indicates its end
i98vtw.why: Opposite arrows show that the hazard continues, not that it ends.

xi8f8k.q: The supplementary panel shown (A) indicates the two permitted directions
xi8f8k.why: Opposite arrows do not show permitted directions; they show the sign's rule continues.

1vqdu78.q: The supplementary panel shown (A) indicates a two-way road
1vqdu78.why: Opposite arrows do not mean a two-way road; they show the sign's validity continues.

1uwbs9n.q: The sign shown indicates the point where the parking ban ends
1uwbs9n.why: The downward arrow under the no-parking sign marks the point where the ban ends.

wadsx1.q: The sign shown marks the point where the stopping ban ends.
wadsx1.why: The no-stopping sign with the right-pointing arrow panel marks the point where the ban ends.

14x9jhd.q: The sign shown indicates the end of the roadworks.
14x9jhd.why: The arrow panel under the roadworks sign marks the point where the roadworks zone (cantiere) ends.

npl95o.q: The sign shown indicates the end of the area reserved for parking.
npl95o.why: The parking sign with the right-pointing arrow marks where the parking area ends.

19vg4t1.q: The sign shown indicates the end of the uneven road surface.
19vg4t1.why: The arrow panel under the uneven-road sign shows where the deformed stretch (strada deformata) ends.

109qaoq.q: The sign shown indicates the end of the slippery road.
109qaoq.why: The right-pointing arrow panel under the slippery-road sign marks the end of the hazardous stretch.

1mop1ve.q: Supplementary panel (A) shown indicates a downhill road.
1mop1ve.why: The vertical arrow panel says nothing about gradients. It only points to the exact spot the sign above refers to.

156rd3u.q: Supplementary panel (B) shown, placed under the PARKING sign, indicates the beginning of the parking area.
156rd3u.why: A right-pointing arrow under the parking sign marks the end of the zone. The start is shown by the opposite arrow.

r8ef75.q: Supplementary panel (A) shown, placed under a prohibition sign, indicates the beginning of the prohibition.
r8ef75.why: The vertical arrow only points to the spot the sign refers to. It does not mark the start of the prohibition.

gua2op.q: Supplementary panel (A) shown indicates a road closed to traffic.
gua2op.why: The vertical arrow panel does not mean closure. It only specifies the point the sign above applies to.

1h4mmj9.q: The sign shown indicates the continuation of the overtaking ban.
1h4mmj9.why: A sign crossed by the black diagonal bar marks the end of the overtaking ban. Continuation is shown by a supplementary panel.

k5j89a.q: Supplementary panel (A) shown indicates the only permitted direction.
k5j89a.why: The vertical arrow does not impose a direction of travel. It points to the place the sign above refers to.

1l48kcu.q: The supplementary panel shown gives advance warning that road markings are temporarily missing from the carriageway.
1l48kcu.why: The panel with the paintbrush on grey background warns that road markings (segnaletica orizzontale) are temporarily missing.

179tamc.q: The supplementary panel shown indicates a stretch of road where road markings are temporarily absent.
179tamc.why: The panel with the paintbrush on grey background warns that road markings (segnaletica orizzontale) are temporarily missing.

482joz.q: The supplementary panel shown indicates that work is under way to repaint the road markings.
482joz.why: The panel signals that road markings (segnaletica orizzontale) are temporarily absent, for example during repainting work.

1pxkcrr.q: The supplementary panel shown is placed under the OTHER HAZARDS sign.
1pxkcrr.why: Pictogram panels like this one, for missing road markings, are used with the OTHER HAZARDS (altri pericoli) sign.

1uwioar.q: The sign shown indicates a closed road.
1uwioar.why: The paintbrush panel does not mean closure. It only signals temporarily missing road markings.

p8soxq.q: The supplementary panel shown indicates a snow-covered road.
p8soxq.why: This panel signals temporarily missing road markings, not snow on the road.

wk76ct.q: The supplementary panel shown indicates the proximity of a pedestrian crossing.
wk76ct.why: This panel signals temporarily missing road markings, not a pedestrian crossing.

o4ujxm.q: The supplementary panel shown gives advance warning of the start of a one-way stretch of road.
o4ujxm.why: This panel signals temporarily missing road markings, not a one-way street.

81e9k6.q: The supplementary panel shown indicates that crossing the solid line is not allowed.
81e9k6.why: The panel only warns that road markings are missing. It does not forbid crossing any solid line.

1sj0nit.q: The supplementary panel shown invites drivers to slow down because of an accident.
1sj0nit.why: The panel showing crashed vehicles warns of an accident on the carriageway, so drivers should slow down.

1wdtdh8.q: The supplementary panel shown indicates crashed vehicles on the carriageway.
1wdtdh8.why: The panel showing crashed vehicles warns of an accident on the carriageway, so drivers should slow down.

16aut76.q: The supplementary panel shown signals that the carriageway is occupied by crashed vehicles.
16aut76.why: The panel showing crashed vehicles warns of an accident on the carriageway, so drivers should slow down.

15x1vuc.q: The supplementary panel shown signals a road accident and therefore the need to reduce speed.
15x1vuc.why: The panel showing crashed vehicles warns of an accident on the carriageway, so drivers should slow down.

17vlxfa.q: The supplementary panel shown indicates a slippery road.
17vlxfa.why: The panel shows crashed vehicles and signals an accident, not a slippery road.

6ydy23.q: The supplementary panel shown indicates to stop and give way to the right.
6ydy23.why: The panel signals an accident on the carriageway. It does not require stopping or giving way.

1ox8b02.q: The supplementary panel shown is found only if the accident occurred on a motorway.
1ox8b02.why: The panel can warn of an accident on any type of road, not only on motorways.

1rj43oi.q: The supplementary panel shown indicates a no-parking restriction.
1rj43oi.why: The panel signals an accident with vehicles on the carriageway, not a parking ban.

1h8aoil.q: The supplementary panel shown gives advance warning of a garage for crashed vehicles.
1h8aoil.why: The panel signals an accident on the road, not a garage for damaged vehicles.

1o30pc3.q: The supplementary panel shown indicates to switch on the lights to avoid accidents.
1o30pc3.why: The panel signals an accident that has happened on the road. It does not tell drivers to switch lights on.

lg5zsf.q: The supplementary panel shown indicates the presence of shunting tracks.
lg5zsf.why: The panel with two steam locomotives warns of shunting or connecting tracks (binari di manovra) near freight yards, used with OTHER HAZARDS.

m29oxd.q: The sign shown indicates a crossing of shunting tracks.
m29oxd.why: The panel with two steam locomotives warns of shunting or connecting tracks (binari di manovra) near freight yards, used with OTHER HAZARDS.

12pbwl1.q: The supplementary panel shown gives advance warning of shunting or connecting tracks near freight yards.
12pbwl1.why: The panel with two steam locomotives warns of shunting or connecting tracks (binari di manovra) near freight yards, used with OTHER HAZARDS.

1czstp0.q: The sign shown invites drivers to reduce speed.
1czstp0.why: The OTHER HAZARDS sign with the shunting-tracks panel calls for caution, so drivers must reduce speed.

110mobs.q: The supplementary panel is paired with the OTHER HAZARDS sign.
110mobs.why: The locomotive panel completes the OTHER HAZARDS (altri pericoli) sign, as pictogram panels do.

5va9ew.q: The supplementary panel indicates an area equipped for model racing.
5va9ew.why: The locomotive panel warns of shunting tracks, not a model-racing area.

saz244.q: The supplementary panel shown indicates to be careful because the road may be crossed by trams.
saz244.why: The panel shows steam locomotives and indicates shunting or connecting tracks, not trams.

y4mqs7.q: The supplementary panel shown must be obeyed by train drivers.
y4mqs7.why: Road signs are addressed to road users, not to train drivers.

gqkz0t.q: The supplementary panel shown indicates a level crossing with two tracks.
gqkz0t.why: The panel warns of shunting or connecting tracks, not a two-track level crossing (passaggio a livello).

1mr0sqz.q: The supplementary panel shown indicates snowploughs at work on the road.
1mr0sqz.why: The panel with a snowflake and snowplough warns of snowploughs (sgombraneve) at work, and is used with OTHER HAZARDS.

1ta4ai3.q: The supplementary panel shown is paired with the OTHER HAZARDS sign.
1ta4ai3.why: The panel with a snowflake and snowplough warns of snowploughs (sgombraneve) at work, and is used with OTHER HAZARDS.

19fmqee.q: The supplementary panel shown invites drivers to slow down because of snowploughs in operation.
19fmqee.why: The panel signals snowploughs in operation, so drivers must slow down and take care.

18ailsn.q: The supplementary panel shown invites drivers to keep at least 20 metres away from snowploughs in operation.
18ailsn.why: The panel calls for caution and a gap of at least 20 metres from working snowploughs.

1j14pn4.q: The supplementary panel shown indicates to pay attention to snowploughs on the road.
1j14pn4.why: The panel with a snowflake and snowplough warns of snowploughs (sgombraneve) at work, and is used with OTHER HAZARDS.

1bgcshu.q: The supplementary panel shown is placed on snowy roads to signal the presence of snowploughs.
1bgcshu.why: The panel with a snowflake and snowplough warns of snowploughs (sgombraneve) at work, and is used with OTHER HAZARDS.

ay733d.q: The supplementary panel shown indicates the construction of a playground nearby.
ay733d.why: The panel shows a snowplough and snowflake, not a playground.

1f650uf.q: The supplementary panel shown indicates a ban on transit for snowploughs.
1f650uf.why: The panel warns of snowploughs at work. It does not ban them from the road.

1s5tzrv.q: The supplementary panel shown indicates the obligation to fit snow chains.
1s5tzrv.why: Chains are required by other signs. This panel only warns of working snowploughs.

147t4xw.q: The supplementary panel shown requires keeping 100 metres away from the working snowplough.
147t4xw.why: The distance to keep from a working snowplough is at least 20 metres, not 100.

ntknzp.q: The supplementary panel shown indicates that the road can only be used after the snowplough has passed.
ntknzp.why: The panel warns of working snowploughs. It does not forbid using the road before they pass.

1suc9aj.q: The supplementary panel shown indicates that on this road you may meet the refuse collection vehicle.
1suc9aj.why: The panel warns of working snowploughs, not refuse collection trucks.

1fmg9js.q: The supplementary panel shown indicates a road that may flood in heavy rain.
1fmg9js.why: The panel with three wavy lines warns of a stretch of road that may flood in heavy rain or storm surge.

j67mhf.q: The supplementary panel shown indicates that we are travelling along a stretch of road that may flood in heavy rain.
j67mhf.why: The panel with three wavy lines warns of a stretch of road that may flood in heavy rain or storm surge.

scbcgv.q: The sign shown indicates that the road may flood in heavy rain.
scbcgv.why: The panel with three wavy lines warns of a stretch of road that may flood in heavy rain or storm surge.

1vwoso.q: The supplementary panel shown indicates the danger of the carriageway flooding in rain or a heavy storm surge.
1vwoso.why: The panel with three wavy lines warns of a stretch of road that may flood in heavy rain or storm surge.

1ortasn.q: The supplementary panel shown indicates a swimming pool nearby.
1ortasn.why: The wavy-line panel warns of flooding risk, not a swimming pool.

18l2d1p.q: The supplementary panel shown indicates a stretch of road covered with snow.
18l2d1p.why: The wavy-line panel warns of flooding, not snow.

a74nmz.q: The supplementary panel shown gives advance warning of a soft shoulder.
a74nmz.why: The wavy-line panel warns of flooding, not a soft shoulder (banchina cedevole).

1q577x0.q: The supplementary panel shown bans transit for vehicles carrying products that could pollute water.
1q577x0.why: The panel warns of flooding. The ban for water-polluting loads uses a different sign.

1fpnl0a.q: The supplementary panel shown indicates a stretch of road where fog may be found.
1fpnl0a.why: The wavy-line panel indicates flooding risk, not fog.
